This guide helps you prepare; it does not calculate your benefit or decide eligibility.

第一步：确认自己在问哪一种福利: Step 1: identify the benefit you are asking about
Social Security 退休金看的是你缴社安税的工作记录；401(k)、: Social Security retirement benefits depend on the work record you paid Social Security tax on; a 401(k), IRA or employer plan is a separate account. SSI is a different benefit for people with limited income and resources who are 65 or older, disabled or blind. Ask about each one separately.
从 SSA 官方页面查看个人估算: View personalized estimates through SSA's official page
从这里进入 my Social Security，看工作记录和领取估算。: Sign in to my Social Security here to see your work record and benefit estimates.
第二步：先看自己的工作记录，别拿朋友的金额比: Step 2: check your own work record, not a friend's amount
SSA 写明：按本人工作记录领退休金需要 40 个工作积分，每年最多 4 个；积: SSA says retirement benefits on your own record take 40 work credits, at most 4 a year; you earn credits only by working and paying Social Security taxes, so ten years of living in the U.S. is not the same as 40 credits. In 2026 you earn one credit for every $1,890 of covered earnings, and $7,560 earns all 4 for the year. Credits decide whether you can claim; the monthly amount comes from your average earnings over your working years, and extra credits do not raise it.
把工作年份、雇主和自雇收入，逐年对照 my Social Security 里的: Check your work years, employers and self-employment income year by year against the record in my Social Security; note any missing year and ask SSA how to correct it.
本人退休金和配偶／前配偶或遗属福利分开问，条件和领取时间不同。: Ask about your own benefit and spouse, ex-spouse or survivor benefits separately; the rules and timing differ.
有移民身份、境外工作或打算长住国外的情况，直接问 SSA 对应的规则。: If immigration status, work abroad or living abroad applies, ask SSA directly about those rules.
家庭收入和资源较少的，另外问 SSI；退休金的积分和 SSI 资格是两回事。: If household income and resources are low, ask about SSI too; retirement credits and SSI eligibility are separate.
第三步：比较时间，分清领取月份和到账月份: Step 3: compare timing and distinguish the benefit month from the payment month
本人退休金最早 62 岁可领，早领每月金额会降低；晚领每月更多，增额到 70 岁: You can start your own benefit at 62, with a smaller monthly amount; waiting raises it, up to age 70. For anyone born in 1960 or later, full retirement age is 67. The 2026 cost-of-living adjustment (COLA) is 2.8%, starting with benefits for January 2026; the 2027 adjustment is 3.6%, starting with benefits for January 2027.
SSA 允许最早在想开始领取的月份前四个月申请，第一笔钱一般在所选月份的下一个月: SSA lets you apply up to four months before the month you want benefits to start, and the first payment usually arrives the month after that month. If you will still work before full retirement age, ask about the annual earnings limit and benefits that may be withheld. Medicare sign-up is separate: delaying retirement benefits does not delay Medicare enrollment.
查自己的完全退休年龄: Look up your full retirement age
在 SSA 计算器按出生年份查日期，再比较本人账号的估算。: Use SSA's calculator to check the date by birth year, then compare your account estimates.
SSA 在 2026 年 10 月公布了 2027 年的数字。2026 年的数字: SSA published the 2027 figures in October 2026. The 2026 figures still apply through the end of 2026, so keep the two years apart.
生活费调整（COLA）：2026 年 2.8%；2027 年 3.6%。社安金从: Cost-of-living adjustment (COLA): 2.8% in 2026; 3.6% in 2027. Social Security rises with benefits payable in January 2027; the SSI increase starts with the payment on December 31, 2026.
工作积分：2026 年每 $1,890 受保收入记 1 个；2027 年每 $1: Work credits: one per $1,890 of covered earnings in 2026; one per $1,970 in 2027. You can earn at most 4 a year, and retirement still takes 40.
SSI 联邦标准（每月最多）：2026 年个人 $994、夫妻 $1,491；2: SSI federal payment standard (monthly maximum): $994 for an individual and $1,491 for a couple in 2026; $1,029 and $1,544 in 2027. The resource limit is the same in both years: $2,000 for an individual, $3,000 for a couple.
加州的 SSP 是州政府在 SSI 之上另加的补助，由 SSA 一起发放；它的金: California's SSP is a state payment added on top of SSI, paid by SSA along with it; its amount is not part of the federal standard above, and SSA works out what you personally receive each month.
还没到完全退休年龄又在工作：全年收入限制 2026 年 $24,480、2027: Working before full retirement age: the yearly earnings limit is $24,480 in 2026 and $25,560 in 2027, and SSA withholds $1 of benefits for every $2 above it. In the year you reach full retirement age, the limit for the months before that month is $65,160 in 2026 and $67,920 in 2027, with $1 withheld for every $3 above it; from the month you reach full retirement age there is no limit.
缴社安税的工资上限：2026 年 $184,500，2027 年 $192,30: Earnings subject to Social Security tax: up to $184,500 in 2026 and $192,300 in 2027; the Medicare tax has no such limit.
2026 和 2027 两栏并列，包括积分、收入限制和 SSI。: 2026 and 2027 side by side, including credits, earnings limits and SSI.
第四步：带着清单联系 SSA，可以要求口译: Step 4: contact SSA with your questions and request an interpreter
SSA 的电话和办公室都提供免费口译。拨打 1-800-772-1213，跟接线: SSA offers free interpreters by phone and in its offices. Call 1-800-772-1213 and tell the agent you need a Chinese interpreter; follow what SSA tells you about appointments and documents. Family can help prepare questions, but the account and application stay with the person or someone they have authorized.
